description:
After his military service, Beom-Hwan returns to art school. His junior, Tae-Yeon, reveals a secret he'd wanted to keep hidden from his former schoolmates. Tae-Yeon notices a bounty on campus for ghost stories, and together with her physical education student, Ma-Ri, Tae-Yeon persuades Beom-Hwan, whose secrets she's uncovered, to solve the mystery. As they unravel the mysteries of the Burberry Man, animal abuse, and hidden cameras, Beom-Hwan and Ma-Ri begins to develop feelings for each other. Having never dated before, they struggle to figure out how to approach each other...

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)
